From: Marta Santos <marta.santos@oakbridge.com>

Cc: procurement@oakbridge.com
Date: 2026-08-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Oakbridge contract kickoff: MSA + Order Form

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for picking this up. We're preparing to go into procurement for a vendor agreement and want to kick off the MSA + Order Form work so legal can review redlines early. Attached are our current MSA (Oakbridge_MSA_v1.2.docx) and a draft order form (OrderForm_Oakbridge_2026.xlsx). I've also attached our SOC2 snapshot for your security team.

High-level asks from our side:
- Can Redwood confirm which template you'd prefer us to redline against (company template vs. counterparty redline)?
- Who should own the initial redline consolidation?
- We're sensitive to data residency and would like your default residency language called out early.

Availability: procurement team can do an intake call this week (Tue/Wed 10:00–13:00 PT).

Marta Santos
Sr. Procurement Manager
Oakbridge Systems
Procurement: procurement@oakbridge.com

Attachments: Oakbridge_MSA_v1.2.docx (docx), OrderForm_Oakbridge_2026.xlsx (xls/xlsx), SOC2-Snapshot.pdf (pdf)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marta Santos <marta.santos@oakbridge.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-09T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Oakbridge contract kickoff: MSA + Order Form

Marta — thanks for sending these. Looping in Kimberly (contracts lead) and Jonas (security/compliance) to route the asks.

Quick plan from our side:
1) Template choice: we generally ask counterparty to redline your version against our standard MSA for speed. Kimberly — can you confirm if we should instead send our template and ask Oakbridge to redline that?
2) Initial redline owner: Kimberly suggested we accept Oakbridge redlines and run a consolidated pass; if they prefer we can provide a marked-up template first.
3) Residency & SOC2: Jonas, can you confirm if the SOC2 snapshot triggers any additional evidence requests (logs, residency addendum)?

Action items for Oakbridge before intake call:
- Fill the attached party worksheet (party_sheet_oakbridge.xlsx) with signer names, billing address, and seat counts.
- Confirm preferred redline flow (we've found fastest path is "counterparty redlines first" but we can provide a clean-template redline if you prefer).
- Share prime contact for legal and for procurement.

Suggested intake times: Wed 2026-08-11 10:00 PT or Wed 2026-08-11 11:30 PT. If neither works, propose alternatives.

I'll prepare an initial mapping doc and a redline owner tracker and upload to the deal folder once we agree.

Thanks,

Lauren Bishop
Sr. Manager, Contracts Ops
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

Attachment referenced: party_sheet_oakbridge.xlsx (xls/xlsx) — please complete prior to kickoff.

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Lauren — quick internal note before we lock times.

A few points from contracting:
- If Oakbridge redlines their MSA, ask them to track changes and keep an issues log for any commercial/SLA deviations. That speeds review.
- We should reserve the right to push for our indemnity and limitation language; if there are material carveouts on SLA or data residency, we may need to escalate pricing or an exception through Sales.
- I'll take lead on consolidation and draft a first-pass redline within 48 hours of receiving their tracked file.

Jonas — please flag anything in SOC2-Snapshot.pdf that requires immediate evidence (e.g., cross-region log retention, customer audit support). Also confirm whether we need to surface a residency appendix for Oakbridge's requested jurisdiction.

Lauren — I'll draft the "redline owner tracker" and a short intake checklist (what we need from Oakbridge: signer, seat counts, PO terms, required compliance evidence). I'll drop them in the Drive link once ready.

- Kimberly
